007package com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent;
008
009import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
010import java.util.Map;
011import java.util.Set;
012
013/**
014 * Immutable parameters for a built-in SQL tool.
015 *
016 * <p>Unset parameters are omitted. The database validates required fields
017 * and tool-specific rules, allowing this model to represent partial updates.
018 * Additional parameters are retained for newer database releases.</p>
019 *
020 * @see ToolParams
021 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/CreateSqlToolSample.html">
022 *      CreateSqlToolSample source</a>
023 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/ToolParamsSample.html">
024 *      ToolParamsSample source</a>
025 * @since 1.1.0
026 */
027public final class SqlToolParams implements ToolParams {
028    /** Database parameter names with typed setters or fixed values. */
029    private static final Set<String> KNOWN_NAMES = Set.of("profile_name");
030    /** Immutable database parameters, including unknown fields. */
031    private final Map<String, Object> values;
032
033    SqlToolParams(Map<String, ?> values) {
034        this.values = ToolParamsSupport.snapshot(values);
035    }
036
037    /**
038     * Creates a builder for SQL tool parameters.
039     *
040     * @return new mutable builder
041     * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/CreateSqlToolSample.html">
042     *      CreateSqlToolSample source</a>
043     */
044    public static Builder builder() {
045        return new Builder();
046    }
047
048    /**
049     * Returns the Select AI profile name.
050     *
051     * @return Select AI profile name, or null when unset
052     * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/ToolParamsSample.html">
053     *      ToolParamsSample source</a>
054     */
055    public String getProfileName() {
056        return (String) values.get("profile_name");
057    }
058
059    /**
060     * {@inheritDoc}
061     *
062     * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/ToolParamsSample.html">
063     *      ToolParamsSample source</a>
064     */
065    @Override
066    public Map<String, Object> toMap() {
067        return values;
068    }
069
070    /**
071     * Builder for immutable {@link SqlToolParams}.
072     *
073     * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/CreateSqlToolSample.html">
074     *      CreateSqlToolSample source</a>
075     */
076    public static final class Builder {
077        /** Parameters assembled by this builder. */
078        private final Map<String, Object> values = new LinkedHashMap<>();
079
080        private Builder() {
081        }
082
083        /**
084         * Sets the Select AI profile name.
085         *
086         * @param profileName Select AI profile name, or null to omit it
087         * @return this builder
088         * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/CreateSqlToolSample.html">
089         *      CreateSqlToolSample source</a>
090         */
091        public Builder profileName(String profileName) {
092            ToolParamsSupport.put(values, "profile_name", profileName);
093            return this;
094        }
095
096        /**
097         * Snapshots an additional database parameter.
098         *
099         * @param name database JSON parameter name
100         * @param value JSON-compatible value, including null
101         * @return this builder
102         * @throws IllegalArgumentException when the name is blank, is a known
103         *         parameter name, or the value is not JSON-compatible
104         * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/ToolParamsSample.html">
105         *      ToolParamsSample source</a>
106         */
107        public Builder additionalParameter(String name, Object value) {
108            ToolParamsSupport.additionalParameter(values, KNOWN_NAMES, name, value);
109            return this;
110        }
111
112        /**
113         * Builds an immutable snapshot without database-specific validation.
114         *
115         * @return immutable parameters
116         * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/CreateSqlToolSample.html">
117         *      CreateSqlToolSample source</a>
118         */
119        public SqlToolParams build() {
120            return new SqlToolParams(values);
121        }
122    }
123}
